notes.content: Bunch of stuff. Load it up and check it out.

notes.title: PinBuilder Experimental Branch is now live!
notes.content:
For those who own the game, you can install the Experimental version of PinBuilder to test and see where things are going in the next update. 

NOTE: This version of the game acts the same with regard to files as the main game! Be careful when saving your games from this version as there could be changes between the two iterations. In all likelihood, you will not face any issues. Just be aware of this.
